scope: Static APK/resource inspection and component tests; no phone FPS/RAM/GPU measurements

changes.old: 356 custom models, twoLODs, approximately42MB container; body-loader detours
changes.new: removed from update advertisement; default native long-sleeve path; no detailed/common body detours
changes.expected_effect: less custom asset loading and simpler skinning; container size is not a VRAM measurement

changes.new: original native manager assets and portraits restored
changes.expected_effect: removes the added manager rendering workload

changes.old: global inflate callback tracked every zlib stream
changes.new: no inflate detour; identical glyph layouts are applied once to12 resource files
changes.expected_effect: removes extra tracking and locks during decompression

changes.old: classic NPC rating projection ran twice per lookup
changes.new: one projection after position proficiency is set; native regression suite passed
changes.expected_effect: less repeated CPU work; rating targets unchanged

changes.old: two independent engine hash scans; a matching release marker skipped repair
changes.new: shared process hash cache plus immutable-file repair; verified large resources reuse size/mtime cache
changes.expected_effect: less duplicate reading on repeated starts; first verification still reads the files

changes.new: ten-second monitoring; repeated configuration-file polling removed
same existing face assets; two new exact-card aliases reuse the NV17/NX27 profiles
changes.expected_effect: no new face textures created; current quality retained

changes.new: UI5 lazy preview/render batching and editor response caching retained; user save is not rewritten
changes.expected_effect: no speculative FPS claim for the phone

limits: A large APK/resource download alone does not identify a runtime frame-rate bottleneck. Remaining phone-specific throttling, GPU load and storage latency require measurements on that device.
